scope: P2 feasibility overlay: unchanged P1 signal and risk gates with a modeled target that exceeds $5 net at the 15 bp cost scenario.

assumptions.purpose: Replay unchanged P1 signals chronologically under a single-position, rounded-sizing, hypothetical full-fill policy so candidate-independent statistics can be compared with portfolio-constrained outcomes.

history.primary_price_data: Binance BTCUSDT trade OHLC, 1m; retained research proxy only
history.holdout_status: The complete inspected period is development material, not an untouched holdout.

portfolio_policy.initial_cash_basis: Matches the existing B0 research account convention; it is not the user's account balance or a recommended allocation.
portfolio_policy.candidate_policy: Only unchanged candidates passing the existing 15 bp cost/R and 2.5 ATR stop gates can be considered. Evaluate candidates in chronological decision-time order. A candidate while a position is open, during the existing three-bar post-exit or post-submit cooldown, or failing post-rounding contract/risk checks is skipped and recorded.
portfolio_policy.same_time_conflicts: If multiple candidate events occur at the same profile decision timestamp, mark all as conflict-blocked rather than choose a side by row order.
portfolio_policy.pending_orders: No pending period is simulated. Accepted submissions receive an immediate complete hypothetical fill; unfilled limits, partial fills, queue position, rejection, and cancel/fill races are unknown.
portfolio_policy.entry_fill: Assume a full fill at the rounded strategy limit, which is offset 2 bp from the planned next-execution-bar open. This is a conditional model price, not an observed fill.
portfolio_policy.barrier_data: Start at the candidate decision minute and scan trade 1m OHLC. A stop gap exits at that minute's open; a target gap receives that open; if both barriers occur in a minute, use stop-first. No time exit is imposed.
portfolio_policy.data_end: Do not force-close an open position. Keep it open and report end mark-to-market plus a hypothetical round-trip liquidation cost separately.
portfolio_policy.funding: Excluded; it is a separate signed cashflow and target treatment remains unresolved.
portfolio_policy.intraday_equity: Report daily close marked equity; do not characterize it as intraday maximum drawdown.
portfolio_policy.venue_filter_limit: Use the captured static tick, quantity, and notional filter values; do not model the dynamic mark-price-based PERCENT_PRICE rejection filter. The venue is unconfirmed.

contract_grid_and_sizing.source: Captured Binance BTCUSDT USD-M contract snapshot, used as a historical research proxy; venue remains unconfirmed.
contract_grid_and_sizing.entry_rounding: Long floor to tick; short ceil to tick.
contract_grid_and_sizing.stop_rounding: Long ceil toward entry; short floor toward entry.
contract_grid_and_sizing.target_rounding: Long ceil to preserve reward; short floor to preserve reward.
contract_grid_and_sizing.post_rounding_gate: Require directional entry/stop/target geometry, quantity minimum/maximum, entry and protective minimum notional, and quantity*(rounded_entry_stop_distance + rounded_entry_limit*sizing_cost_fraction) <= risk budget. The source's min(protective levels)*quantity check is used.
contract_grid_and_sizing.strategy_cash: Initial cash plus realized gross PnL minus the simulator's modeled 5 bp commission on each executed side. Hypothetical non-fee execution drag is not included in strategy cash sizing, matching the strategy adapter's separation of simulator cash fees from the risk reserve.

cost_scenarios.pnl_formula: directional quote PnL minus round_trip_fraction * average(entry_notional, exit_notional); charge scenario once.
cost_scenarios.components: 10 bp represents two reference 5 bp commissions. 15 bp adds hypothetical 5 bp non-fee drag; 20 bp adds hypothetical 10 bp non-fee drag. Actual account fees, spread, slippage, funding, and fills are unknown.
cost_scenarios.notional: Linear BTC quantity; quote PnL is quantity * signed price change.

risk_and_result_reporting.daily_equity: Initial research cash + cumulative closed net PnL under a cost scenario + any open position's theoretical liquidation net PnL at that UTC day's final trade close.
risk_and_result_reporting.profit_factor: Sum of positive closed net PnL divided by absolute sum of negative closed net PnL; undefined when there are no losses.
risk_and_result_reporting.open_trade: Excluded from closed trade win rate, expectancy, and profit factor; reported separately with gross mark PnL and estimated cost to liquidate.
risk_and_result_reporting.activity: Report triggers, 15 bp gate passes, order eligibility, assumed fills, cooldown/position/rounding rejections, and closed trades separately. Actual order/fill counts remain NOT_OBSERVED/UNKNOWN.

native_backtest_limit.result: The connected TakeProfit plan rejected the request; no native backtest result was produced.

candidate_outputs.target_quote_semantics: The rounded theoretical P2 target after size calculation; it may be present even if a subsequent notional or risk check rejects the order.

result_semantics.profitability: unproven; hypothetical immediate fills and inspected history do not establish live or prospective profitability
